statement: Define default worksets (shared levels and grids, views, families) created when worksharing starts.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Default Worksets

superiority: Offer workset templates by project type.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Enabling worksharing creates the default workset set with the right names.

statement: Borrow an element on edit and release it on sync without taking whole workset ownership.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Element Borrowing

superiority: Merge compatible edits to the same element at parameter level, not element lock.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A second user can edit another element but not the borrowed one.

statement: Detect and report conflicts when two users change the same element, with a resolve prompt.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Ownership Conflicts

superiority: Resolve conflicts with a three-way merge view.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A conflicting edit is rejected with a message naming the owner.

statement: Control which worksets are visible in each view through a workset visibility setting.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Visibility in Views

notes: Acceptance sketch: Hidden workset elements disappear from the view only.

statement: Choose all, editable, last viewed or specify when opening a workshared file.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Open Worksets on Open

superiority: Predict open time from selected worksets.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Opening with 'specify' loads only chosen worksets.

statement: Close worksets to reduce loaded geometry and memory in a session.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Memory Management by Closing

superiority: Stream worksets lazily with no manual management.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Memory use falls after closing a heavy workset.

statement: Open and close worksets of a linked Revit model from the link dialog.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Workset of Linked Models

superiority: Remember per-view workset state of links.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Closed link workset removes its geometry in views.

statement: Reassign selected elements to another workset.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Move Elements Between Worksets

superiority: Bulk reassign by rule with preview.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Moved elements report the new workset.

statement: Show who owns and borrows each element in the properties.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Element Ownership Display

notes: Acceptance sketch: Owner parameter equals the user name.

statement: Save to a local file without syncing and receive reminders.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Save Locally and Reminders

notes: Acceptance sketch: Local save leaves central unchanged.

statement: Specify central model path and relative path behaviour for teams.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Central Model Locations

superiority: Cloud path resolves without drive mapping.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Path resolves for a second user.

statement: Audit and compact files and recover from corrupt local or central copies.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Recovery from Corruption

superiority: Self-healing sync with continuous integrity checks.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Audit completes and file opens.

statement: Handle elements deleted by one user while another edits them.

source.ref: Worksets: Synchronize Conflicts with Deleted Elements
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Synchronize Conflicts with Deleted Elements

notes: Acceptance sketch: Sync prompts and preserves deleted state per rules.

statement: Control who can edit which worksets through project roles in cloud collaboration.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: User Permissions

superiority: Fine roles per category and area.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A restricted user cannot edit a protected workset.

statement: Families and types are shared across worksets with ownership at the type level.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Workshared Families and Types

superiority: Allow type edits with auto-merge when parameters differ.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Type edit requires type ownership.

statement: Reduce sync time through incremental save and background compaction.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Sync Time Budget

superiority: Incremental sync independent of model size.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Sync time on a seeded 500 MB model stays under the performance budget.

statement: Support splitting a project across linked models by discipline or zone.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Model Split Strategy

superiority: Show a suggestion engine for splitting heavy models.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Linked parts together have the full element set.

statement: Back up the central and detach with worksets preserved for archive.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Backup and Detach Workflow

notes: Acceptance sketch: Archive reopens as a standalone model.

statement: List elements currently borrowed or owned by each user so the team can coordinate.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Worksets: Borrowed Elements Report

superiority: Show the list as a live panel with click-to-zoom.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Report lists exactly the elements borrowed in a seeded two-user session.
